application.name: KouMessenger
application.desc:
This is the stable non-root patched-kushion build of KouMessenger.
Current patch bundle: De-Vanced (RookieEnough/De-Vanced) Patch frontend: MorpheApp/morphe-desktop Upstream package: com.facebook.orca Stable package identity: de.kwoo.shion.messenger
